dependencies.name: three
dependencies.modifications: None in vendored upstream files. World Server bundles selected exports into the autonomous Living Ink WebGL NPR artifact at build time.
dependencies.redistributionRequirements: Preserve the MIT copyright and license notice in redistributed/bundled copies.

notes: Living Ink NPR v3 uses audited three.js r160 because it provides a single self-contained ES module suitable for the standalone HTML compiler. Newer r186 splits the build into module/core files, increasing standalone integration surface. No third-party models, textures, fonts, animations, examples, or training data are imported. meshoptimizer and glTF-Transform were reviewed as future MIT candidates but intentionally not imported because this vertical slice does not require them.
